text.tspan: Top: 4× 2N3904 direction switches (G-5500 DIN pins 2/3/4/5) + per-channel indicator LEDs (D1–D4).
Bottom: Adafruit ADS1015 I²C ADC reads the 2.0–4.5 V position feedback (pins 1, 6) via 2× resistor dividers.
See docs/HARDWARE.md for component-value derivation and the G-5500-side circuit it interfaces with.
